title: Takaro module source (module.json)
description: The source definition of one module, stored at modules/<dir>/module.json next to its src/ directory. Every function path is relative to the module directory and must stay inside it.

name.description: Argument name. Unique within the command.

type.description: Argument type, for example string, number, boolean or player.

helpText.description: Shown to players in the command help.

position.description: Position of the argument in the command line. Unique within the command.

defaultValue.description: Value used when the player leaves the argument out.

trigger.description: The word players type to run the command. Defaults to the command's key.

helpText.description: Usage text shown in the command help.

function.description: Path of the JavaScript file with the command code, relative to the module directory.

eventType.description: The Takaro event that triggers the hook, for example chat-message or player-connected.

regex.description: Only run for chat messages that match this regular expression.

function.description: Path of the JavaScript file with the hook code, relative to the module directory.

temporalValue.description: Cron expression for when the job runs.

function.description: Path of the JavaScript file with the job code, relative to the module directory.
Path of the JavaScript file with the shared function code, relative to the module directory.

permission.description: Permission key, checked in module code.

friendlyName.description: Name shown in the role editor.

canHaveCount.description: Whether a role can hold the permission with a count (a numeric limit).

name.description: Module name. For modules listed in the registry it equals the directory name and is kebab-case (see docs/registry-format.md).

author.description: Author shown in Takaro. Defaults to Unknown.

description.description: What the module does. Shown in Takaro and kept in the version file.

summary.description: Optional short description of at most 500 characters. Used as the registry.json description when the full description is longer than 500 characters.

version.description: Semantic version x.y.z. Required for listed modules (validated by the registry validator); a published version can never change.

minTakaroVersion.description: Optional lowest Takaro version (x.y.z) that can run this module. Copied into versionDetails when the version is first published.

supportedGames.description: Games the module supports. Defaults to all.

config.description: JSON schema (draft-07) of the module configuration.

uiSchema.description: JSON Forms UI schema for the module configuration.

defaultSystemConfig.description: Default values for the system config (cron job and command settings) of an installation.

commands.description: Chat commands, keyed by command name.

hooks.description: Event hooks, keyed by hook name.

cronJobs.description: Scheduled jobs, keyed by job name.

functions.description: Shared functions other code in the module can import, keyed by function name.
